description: RailNetEurope, set up in 2004 by European rail infrastructure managers, runs the Network and Corridor Information portal, which gathers the Network Statements of its members and the Corridor Information Documents of the Rail Freight Corridors in one common structure. Network Statements are the documents that tell applicants the conditions for access to each national rail network, published at least four months before the deadline for annual timetable requests. Coverage: RNE members across Europe, among them ÖBB-Infrastruktur, Infrabel, SNCF Réseau, DB InfraGO, RFI, ProRail, Bane NOR, PKP PLK and the Baltic, Balkan and Nordic infrastructure managers; documents for the current and upcoming timetable, updated by the managers and corridors. Format and access: the NCI portal needs a user account and lets users search, compare and combine chapters of several Network Statements and CIDs into one PDF; RNE's network statements page links the latest English Network Statement of each member without login; RNE also runs the Central Reference File Database of location and company codes, downloadable as CSV or XML by registered users. Licence: not read; RNE's legal disclaimer says the material is for information only. Caveats: Network Statements are legal and commercial texts, not tables, so line characteristics and capacity have to be read chapter by chapter; the NCI portal itself was not opened. Simulation uses: access conditions, charges and corridor capacity for international rail freight network flow and capacity planning models. Related records: the ERA Register of Infrastructure (data-era-rinf) and DB InfraGO's infrastructure register (data-db-infrago-infrastructure-register-isr).
